title: fix(app-shell): a member Setup refuses gets the app's no-access page on Setup's settings and marketplace routes

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgHGZA9M9n8sPRHZcTX4oAiQ)_
Fixes #27507

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：没有 Setup 权限的普通成员打开 Setup 的设置页（`system/settings`、`system/settings/NAMESPACE`）和应用市场（`system/marketplace`、`system/marketplace/PACKAGE`）时，不再落进默认应用（如 Showcase）的外壳里看「No settings registered」或原始权限报错，而是和打开 Setup 根路由一样，看到「You don't have access to this app … Back to home」。
- **为什么改**：这些路由带 `system` 段，属于伪路由，过去不等待 Setup 的访问裁决，直接回落到默认应用；三处页面各自解读服务端的拒绝，出了三种说法。分诊裁定：一律走应用根已有的无权限页，不新增文案。
- **风险与回滚**：只改前端外壳的路由判断（一个谓词），服务端拒绝逻辑不变；管理员和能打开该应用的用户行为不变；审批收件箱及其记录页（objectui#12706 留下的开放路由）不受影响。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` 中 `isSettingsOrMarketplaceRoute` 与 `appSurfaceAwaitsVerdict` 两行；然后是新测试 `AppContent.settingsMarketplaceVerdict-27507.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.settingsMarketplaceVerdict-27507.test.tsx`，预期 11 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`AppContent` (app-shell) already waits on the access verdict for the app the URL names on two pseudo-route families, Setup's root and the metadata-admin routes (objectui#12706), and draws `renderAppAccessDenied` on `denied`. This adds a third family to `appSurfaceAwaitsVerdict`: a route whose sub-path is `system/settings...` or `system/marketplace...` (`isSettingsOrMarketplaceRoute`). Nothing else moves:

- The gate still applies only when the URL names an app the loaded list does not carry (`!matchedApp`), so an admin, and any caller under an app they may open, render the pages exactly as before, unprobed.
- Every verdict other than `denied` (`not_found`, `unreachable`, `unknown`, `granted`) falls through to the pseudo-route rendering, unchanged.
- The routes objectui#12706 deliberately left open stay open: the approvals inbox (`system/approvals`, where the server's approval links forward) and the record pages it opens (`OBJECT/record/ID`). Their pins in `AppContent.setupItemRoutesVerdict-12706.test.tsx` are untouched and green.
- The bare `system` landing is not in the set: it forwards onto `system/settings` (the console host's `SystemLandingRedirect`), which is refused. A pin holds that chain.
- No inner component changed. The settings hub's empty state, `SettingsView`'s error text and `MarketplaceAccessDenied` are unreachable for a caller Setup refuses, and stay as they were for a caller Setup admits.
- No server change. The server already refuses each read; this is presentation only.

Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Tests

New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.settingsMarketplaceVerdict-27507.test.tsx`, on the 12706 file's harness (a real `ObjectStackAdapter` over a stubbed `fetch`, so the verdict comes from the real probe reading a real 403 envelope; page stubs count their mounts):

- A refused member on the three settings routes the card names (the hub, `settings/auth`, `settings/localization`), on the marketplace it names, and on a marketplace package page: `app-access-denied`, no `ConsoleLayout`, zero page mounts, exactly one probe and it is Setup's, URL unchanged, the Back-to-home button present.
- Setup's package-id address (`/apps/com.objectstack.setup/system/settings/auth`): same verdict, probed by that address.
- `/apps/setup/system`: forwards to the hub and is refused there.
- Controls: an admitted caller gets the settings page and the marketplace under Setup, unprobed; a server with no such app (404) keeps the old fallback rendering; the settings route under the caller's own app renders the page, unprobed.

Ablation (the predicate disabled via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit 1 to 0, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty): 7 of 11 cases red, the 4 controls green.

## Acceptance notes

- Not filed, observation only: a caller Setup admits but who lacks `manage_platform_settings` can still type `/apps/setup/system/settings/auth` and see `SettingsView` print the server's error message verbatim. The hub does not list that namespace for them, so it is reachable only by URL; not reproduced in a browser here.
- Not in scope and left as they were: the other Setup `system/*` routes the card does not name (`system/apps`, `system/audit-log`, `system/ai-approvals`, `system/profile`). Whether they wait on Setup's verdict is the same product question objectui#12706 left open for the approvals routes.
- Home's marketplace shortcuts already show only to admins, so a member reaches the marketplace route only by URL or an old link.
